icp_note: K-8 schools (public, private, charter) with parent communities able to fund enrichment OR schools with budget for targeted intervention/remedial support; math achievement gaps or competition prep needs.

dimensions.label: Math Achievement Gap
dimensions.guidance: HIGH: School has visible gaps (remedial programs, low test scores, high % struggling students). LOW: Math scores are strong and uniform across student body.

dimensions.label: Parent Willingness to Pay
dimensions.guidance: HIGH: Affluent community, parents already pay for tutoring/enrichment, active PTA. LOW: Title I school, low-income families, no history of paid extracurriculars.

dimensions.label: Openness to External Partners
dimensions.guidance: HIGH: School uses outside vendors (tutoring, SEL, test prep), principal/admin are innovation-friendly. LOW: Insular culture, distrust of edtech, teacher union resistance to external programs.

dimensions.label: Competition/Advanced Math Culture
dimensions.guidance: HIGH: School has Math Olympiad teams, gifted programs, parents push for advanced learning. LOW: No competitive math participation, focus is purely remedial or grade-level.
